answer: When a five-member jury splits, everyone on it loses stake, and the split is written to a public log with the answer text attached. Auditors rotate from a pool each epoch, so a farmer cannot learn the panel in advance. The cost is not the stake alone; it is the public record that a given bridge of trust broke, and that record follows the identity into every later epoch. A crystal of clean history takes months to build on basalt, and one published divergence takes it down.
